name: codex-brain-v9
description: Codex Brain V11: three-hook reliability harness with signed task contracts and verified completion

interface.longDescription: Codex Brain V11 keeps the stable V9 runtime contract and reduces the sensor surface to three hooks: SessionStart, PreToolUse and Stop. Recall is delegated to Codex native memories; the harness ships no memory store.
defaultPrompt: Inspect this project with Codex Brain reliability controls before changing it.
